notes: 2026-10-29 (garage page run): garageclothing.com refuses automated reads. curl with the StylodexBot UA got HTTP 403 on /us/, /, /ca/, /robots.txt, /us/help/, /us/sitemap.xml and /us/products.json; WebFetch of /us/ got 403. Not worked around. So known_for, size_range, ships_to, returns_days, free shipping and prices are empty (store-only facts).

Status verified from the parent company's official sites (enrich.md §2): groupedynamite.com links www.garageclothing.com/ca/ and says GDI 'operates retail stores and digital experiences under two complementary and spirited banners: Garage and Dynamite', founded in Montreal, 'Since 1975'. investors.groupedynamite.com (TSX: GRGD): 'we operate across Canada and the United States, and more recently expanded into the United Kingdom'.

us_stores: Q2 fiscal 2026 release (Sep 10 2026): 'Opening of 7 new stores: 6 in the United States and 1 in the United Kingdom, both under the GARAGE banner' and 'Renovation or relocation of stores: ... 3 in the United States, both under the GARAGE banner'. Investor presentation slide 19 (store count as of Aug 1 2026): 307 stores, US 141 stores across 41 states, Canada 163, UK 3; the chart reads as 238 GARAGE (96 Canada, 139 US, 3 UK) and 69 DYNAMITE, but the split is a chart reading, not stated in text.

Wikipedia (Garage (clothing retailer)): founded in Montreal in 1975 as a Groupe Dynamite subsidiary; 'primarily targeting young women'; areas served Canada, United Kingdom, United States. The disco directory profile (discobrands.co/brands/garage, facts checked October 2026) also gives founded 1975 and says most pieces cost about $30 to $90 (not a store price; not used).

Ahrefs top pages for www.garageclothing.com/us/ (US, 2026-10-28): sweatpants category page has the most traffic (11,186; top keyword 'sweatpants'), then sweatsuits (6,839) and hoodies-sweatshirts (6,160), going-out tops (4,789).
